label: Finite interpretations for the seven derivations of causal maps batch 1: for…, by Explicit finite…
meaning: Finite interpretations for the seven derivations of causal maps batch 1: for each premise other than excluded middle, one model (from scripts/countermodel.py, checked by decide) in which the other premises hold and the conclusion fails, and one joint model with nonempty causing, moving, self-moving and efficient-causing relations in which every premise and conclusion of the batch holds. Satisfiability and omission only; no model is claimed to describe reality.
